description: I am an individual who enjoys creating interesting projects using ai and technology. It brings me a lot of joy when I can create a project from scratch using my own ideas and a large amount of creativity in its user interface design.
summary:
however, there is much more to take into account than a simple selection of an appropriate site on the map. The chosen location may seem quite fitting in the beginning but once you take into consideration such factors as the amount of sunlight, visibility of the Earth for communication purposes, or possible delays in the process, everything becomes much more complicated.

This is where our application Moonis comes in.with it, you will be able to see all the mentioned factors in one tool and compare your options.

The problem we were curious about was quite simple what would happen to the plan once something went wrong? We created Moonis in order to facilitate investigation of such problems and possible solutions.

Our intention was to create an application that would make lunar mission planning accessible and would not compromise its scientific nature in any way.
details:
Reasons for creating Moonis

Selection of the appropriate location for landing a spacecraft on the Moon is quite challenging task. While a certain landing site may appear to be a proper one, it should be noted that its suitability depends on the moment of time. Sun illumination plays a crucial role in terms of energy supply and visibility. Earth visibility is essential to keep in touch with the landing craft and track its movements. Moreover, mission delays may significantly impact on the initial selection.

That is the very problem we wanted to address.

We started thinking of one specific question. How the landing site selection problem will change, if the originally planned date of landing is postponed or changed? Will the same site remain to be suitable for landing? How the sunlight and Earth visibility will be affected by such a change? How can a user compare different alternatives, taking into account all the factors and without the necessity to study all the data separately?

That is the main problem Moonis is designed to solve.
